record.query: Qwen 3.6-35B-A3B fits single H100 with bf16 LoRA
record.answer: The Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (35B MoE, 34.7B total params) loads at 69.3GB in bf16 on a single H100 80GB. With LoRA r=8 adding 4.1M trainable params and gradient checkpointing, total memory is ~68.7GB (84% of 81.5GB). model.gradient_checkpointing_enable() + model.enable_input_require_grads() replaces prepare_model_for_kbit_training for non-quantized models. No quantization needed — bf16 fits.
